chapter: Bucking contests, boogie woogie and rhythm
title: Rhythm names, afterbeat and the Smokey Mary drum feel
summary: He says he had no special names for rhythms, explains the two-beat afterbeat and how his train-wheel rhythms led to Smokey Mary.
